description: Omni Agent — Give agents a task and get an auditable result, not a promise. Execute source-attributed news research, customer-authorized smart-light actions or verify a Base transaction receipt. Each operation returns explicit execution evidence; it cannot sign a wallet transaction, pay without confirmation or bypass device permissions. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

cloud_host.description: For light actions: customer-owned Home Assistant Cloud hostname; token in X-Provider-Key

entity_id.description: For light actions: explicitly authorized light entity ID

query.description: Required for research: topic or event

tx_hash.description: For transaction receipt: 0x plus 64 hex characters on Base

name: api_omni_agent
